summary: This is a SOAP request template for validating a VAT (Value Added Tax) number against the European Commission's VIES database. It wraps a checkVat service call with placeholder values that will be substituted with an actual country code and VAT number at runtime.

explanations.2: This creates a SOAP envelope, which is the standard wrapper format for SOAP web service requests — think of it as the postal envelope that contains the actual message being sent.
explanations.4: This specifies which web service method we're calling (checkVat) and which namespace it belongs to, so the remote server knows exactly what we're asking for.
explanations.5: The %COUNTRY% is a placeholder that will be replaced with an actual two-letter country code (like 'DE' for Germany) before the request is sent.
explanations.6: The %VATNUMBER% is a placeholder that will be replaced with the actual VAT identification number we want to validate.
